name: Olanzapine
executiveSummary: Atypical antipsychotic. Adult: **5–10 mg PO/day** (range **5–20 mg**). Agitation IM: **10 mg** (max 3 doses/day, ≥2 h apart). High metabolic risk (weight, diabetes). Dementia: ↑ mortality.
indications:
## Indications

- Schizophrenia; bipolar mania; acute agitation (IM).

## Precautions

- Metabolic syndrome — monitor weight, glucose, lipids.
- Sedation, hypotension; rare NMS, tardive dyskinesia.
- IM: do not mix in syringe with IV benzodiazepines (separation protocols).

> Orodispersible useful if adherence/intake uncertain.

adulto.presentation: Tabs 2.5–5–10–15–20 mg; ODT; IM ampoule 10 mg.
adulto.dose: Start **5–10 mg PO at night**; maintenance **10–20 mg/day** (max **20 mg**). Agitation: **10 mg IM**; repeat if needed (max **30 mg/day** IM).

pediatrico.dose: Adolescents (≥13 y schizophrenia/mania per label): start **2.5–5 mg**; max **20 mg** — specialist.

stability:
## Stability

- IM ampoule: use after reconstitution per label.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Weight gain, somnolence, dry mouth, constipation, hyperglycemia; rare: NMS, hepatitis.

bibliography.citation: FDA. Olanzapine — metabolic and dementia warnings.
